app.name: WUP Installer GX2
app.short_description: Wii U public title installer (100% Offline, Aroma & HBL).
app.long_description: Wii U title installer with GUI based on Loadiine GX2. Installs games, updates, and DLC to NAND or USB storage. Completely offline: does not require Wi-Fi, Ethernet, or internet access. Features batch install stability fixes, MCP handle recycling, wudump directory support, and automatic install cleanup.
